column3: MT 13:23. “Lay down” is rendered “slept,” and “was at peace” as “was undisturbed.”
MT 14:2. “Altars of foreignness” is rendered “foreign altars”; “Asherah poles” is rendered “Asherim.”
MT 14:3. “Said to Judah” is rendered “commanded Judah.”
MT 14:4. “Was at peace before him” is rendered “was undisturbed under him.”
MT 14:5. “There was not with him war” is rendered “there was no one at war with him.”
MT 14:6. “The land is still before us” is rendered “The land is still ours.” NASB supplies “with.”
MT 14:7. “Bend a bow” is rendered “wielding bows.”
MT 14:8. “The Cushite” is rendered “the Ethiopian,” and “a thousand thousands” as “a million men.”
MT 14:9. “Before him” is rendered “to meet him,” and “to Mareshah” as “at Mareshah.”

MT 14:10. “There is not with you to help between great and not strength” is rendered with supplied words (“no one besides You to help in the battle between the powerful and those who have no strength”). “Depend on” is rendered “trust in,” and “retain” as “prevail.”
MT 14:11. “Defeated” is rendered “routed,” and “the Cushites” as “the Ethiopians.”
MT 14:12. “To there was not preservation to them” is rendered “so many … fell that they could not recover.”
MT 14:13. “Struck down” is rendered “destroyed”; NASB supplies “had fallen.”
MT 14:14. “The tents of livestock” is rendered “those who owned livestock.”
